summary: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corp., through its subsidiary Booz Allen Hamilton Inc., entered a stock purchase agreement on June 19, 2026 to acquire all equity of Ultra Electronics Advanced Tactical Systems, Inc. from Ultra I C Holdings Limited and Ultra Electronics Holdings Limited for $720 million, subject to adjustments. The transaction is expected to close in Q2 of Booz Allen's fiscal 2027. Closing is subject to customary conditions including HSR waiting period expiration and absence of governmental orders. No board recommendation or advisor named. The acquisition expands Booz Allen's defense electronics capabilities. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competing bids.
